chk_donations_payment_method.name: chk_donations_payment_method
chk_donations_payment_method.value: "donations"."payment_method" IS NULL OR "donations"."payment_method" IN ('Cash', 'Check', 'Bank Transfer', 'Mobile Money', 'Card', 'Online', 'Other')

chk_donations_description.name: chk_donations_description
chk_donations_description.value: ("donations"."donation_purpose" != 'Other') OR ("donations"."donation_purpose" = 'Other' AND "donations"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "donations"."description" != '')

chk_follow_ups_contact_method.name: chk_follow_ups_contact_method
chk_follow_ups_contact_method.value: "follow_ups"."contact_method" IS NULL OR "follow_ups"."contact_method" IN ('Phone Call', 'Text Message', 'Email', 'WhatsApp', 'In-Person Visit', 'Other')

chk_follow_ups_contact_status.name: chk_follow_ups_contact_status
chk_follow_ups_contact_status.value: "follow_ups"."contact_status" IN ('Successful', 'No Answer', 'Wrong Number', 'Call Back Later', 'Not Interested', 'Interested')

chk_forms_target_consistency.name: chk_forms_target_consistency
chk_forms_target_consistency.value: ("forms"."scope" = 'Church-wide' AND "forms"."target_branch_id" IS NULL) OR ("forms"."scope" = 'Branch-specific' AND "forms"."target_branch_id" IS NOT NULL)

idx_members_phone_active.name: idx_members_phone_active
idx_members_phone_active.where: phone IS NOT NULL AND is_active = TRUE

idx_souls_phone_outreach.name: idx_souls_phone_outreach
idx_souls_phone_outreach.where: phone IS NOT NULL AND outreach_id IS NOT NULL

idx_souls_email_outreach.name: idx_souls_email_outreach
idx_souls_email_outreach.where: email IS NOT NULL AND outreach_id IS NOT NULL
